data.reference_sensory: public raw 0-6 expert panel (external paper), same 250 beers

limitations.stale_hops: constrained using trained Q1 sensory proxy, not analytically guaranteed true sensory rating
limitations.chemical: for measured values numerical nonworsening in 1.csv scale; missing source defect values conservatively imputed at minimum and cannot be independently verified; no certified odor thresholds
limitations.rare_styles: classes with <5 beers have no independent test items, report extrapolation limits
limitations.conditional_flow: deep model used in contest as research candidate; selection based on held-out NLL, no forced superiority

detection_floor_calibration.indicator_definition: same observed column minimum in >=25% of training beers (possible detection floor; not proven LOD)
detection_floor_calibration.limitations: Floor mass learned only from training beer cohorts for holdout; artificial minima are proxies, not proven instrument censor values.

optimized_transfer.constraint_definition: 4 measured features numeric source upper bound, stale_hops Q1 estimated score source upper bound
optimized_transfer.candidate_optimization: 100 draws from learned Tripel conditional distribution plus OT candidate; 5 predeclared convex blending factors; minimize Tripel latent distance + .15 source shift subject to all 5 constraints and source shift<6 latent units
